{{Quote|The Mandalorians let us use their village as a staging area, but they're starting to resent our presence. It's time we moved on.|[[Zola Arvannus]]|<ref name="TOR:DC" />}}
'''Outpost Rennar''' was a small [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] located west of [[Breezefield Farms]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TOR:DC" /> where the [[Unidentified Mandalorian Clan (Rennar)|small clan]] would constantly engage against the local [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider tribes]].<ref name="TOR:FStS" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Mandalorians reluctantly allowed the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to use Outpost Rennar as a base for the profit of credits and challenge. But [[Zola Arvannus]] of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] was instructed to acquire an independent location for their outpost; to this end, Imperial forces worked to drive a group of hostile [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] from the nearby farms,<ref name="TOR:DC" /> though they continued to push their limits with their Mandalorian allies as [[Warr'an|Commander Warr'an]] grew to have concerns about their true intentions.

==Behind the scenes==
Outpost Rennar was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It appears as one of the Imperial settlements on the planet Tatooine.<ref name="TOR:OR" />
